messages:
harper: quick note  found a broken TOC anchor in the handbook: /docs/handbook/team-onboarding.md links to #setup-ssh which 404s in staging. anyone owns handbook?
samir: handbook is under people-ops / docs team ownership historically. which file contains the bad link?
harper: the outbound link is in docs/playbooks/new-hire-checklist.md line ~12. It references the ssh section that was renamed last sprint.
tay: i renamed the heading to 'SSH setup & keys' -> slug changed. two easy fixes: update the reference or add a redirect in doclinks.yaml. i'd prefer updating the checklist to the canonical slug and adding a doclinks entry for safety.
link-bot: docs-lint:warning  link-check detected 1 broken fragment in docs/playbooks/new-hire-checklist.md: line ~12
eda: +1 for both. also add `owner: people-ops` to the handbook frontmatter so alerts route correctly. small PR ok.
harper: i'll open the branch. local commands i ran: `rg "setup-ssh" -n docs || true` and then `git checkout -b docs/fix/handbook-ssh-anchor`
harper: patch snippet i used to update the link:
```
python -c "p='docs/playbooks/new-hire-checklist.md'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace('#setup-ssh','#ssh-setup-keys'); open(p,'w').write(s)"
```
ci-bot: pro-tip: run `npm run docs:link-check` locally before pushing to save CI cycles.
harper: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1322  changes: update link in new-hire-checklist.md, add doclinks.yaml redirect from /docs/handbook/team-onboarding#setup-ssh to /docs/handbook/team-onboarding#ssh-setup-keys, add `owner: people-ops` in handbook frontmatter, changelog line.
samir: tagging @tay for a quick review since you changed the heading.
tay: quick skim  LGTM. small nit: prefer redirect key use repo path only (no host). also can you add a unit test in docs/tests/test_doclinks.py asserting the redirect exists?
harper: added test and squashed. pushed update.
ci-bot: build/links  job queued for PR 1322
ci-bot: build/links  job passed
samir: approved. merging once green. thanks for the quick turnaround!
harper: merged. staging preview updated and link resolves. closing the internal ticket. :tada:
